title: Yippee (TBH Creature)
blurb: A squeaky little celebration attached to the TBH Creature, and one of the few genuinely sincere sounds the internet has produced this decade. There is no irony in it whatsoever — small, unguarded joy, which makes it strangely precious in a culture that defaults to sarcasm. Use it for tiny wins: good news, free food, a parcel arriving on the correct day, somebody remembering a thing you mentioned once. It also works as a complete reply to a message, which is more than most words manage. Yippee.
origin: The celebration squeak paired with the TBH Creature meme.
